nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Professor Bann sent word you'd be coming. Let me just check the list...

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Ah, there you are. Your room's all sorted, but I've already handed your key to one of your dormmates.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: There are four of them sharing your room. One of them should have it.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: They're all out and about today, so have a look around campus and find them. I'm sure they'll be glad to meet you.

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: Four dormmates and one key. Guess I'm going looking, then.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: {player}! There you are. I've been holding on to this for you.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Here's your key. Third door along the hall, right in the middle. You can't miss it.

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: I really hope it's big enough for the five of us. Then again, this is a magical academy, so I feel like I don't need to worry about that.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Get some rest. Tomorrow your student guide will show you everything you missed.
